torchwave.approximants.imrphenom_nsbh._l.signature: (m1, m2, s1, s2, mf_ref, mf_anchor, remnant_mass, remnant_spin)
torchwave.approximants.imrphenom_nsbh._l.doc:
Retain the inherited NSBH affine gauge, not a published prescription.

Its constant uses the inspiral phase at the reference frequency; its time
origin uses the raw MR slope at the requested upper frequency, evaluated
with the amplitude remnant. These offsets do not alter intrinsic curvature.

torchwave.approximants.imrphenom_nsbh.nr.signature: (frequency_hz: torch.Tensor, total_mass_sec: torch.Tensor, eta: torch.Tensor, lambda_tilde: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor
torchwave.approximants.imrphenom_nsbh.nr.doc:
Return the additive NRTidalv2 phase correction in radians.

``frequency_hz`` is the positive GW (2,2) frequency.  The tidal
deformability is the usual mass-weighted ``Lambda_tilde``.  No reference
phase or time shift is applied here: those affine choices belong to the
PhenomD baseline in the NSBH assembly (Thompson et al. Sec. II.B).
